tools.name: workface
tools.description: A workface is a short, links-first notes file (~/.claude/workface/<tranche>/workface.md) the mod re-attaches after every compaction and on resume. Use for long multi-agent or multi-session work, or when the owner says "start a tranche", "resume the thread" or "where were we". Actions: start (writes a skeleton), attach, resume, log (appends `entry` to the log, time stamped by the mod), archive (moves all but the last `keep` log entries, default 10, verbatim to the tranche's log/ folder, indexed with your `summary`), detach. Main session only: a subagent shares its id.
